text:
Europe/Athens is UTC+2 in summer; Europe/Paris is UTC+1 in summer in modern times, but for year 1211, time zones did not exist.  
Assuming the question intends a simple 1-hour difference (Athens ahead of Paris), then 4 AM Athens = 3 AM in Paris.  
Date remains August 6, 1211.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1211-08-06 03:00
